items.docs: • This API endpoint returns records of schedule deletions and match time modifications from the past 24 hours. • You can use it with the Schedule & Results (Basic) endpoint to keep locally stored match data in sync. • Tips: You have access to all the basketball Common API endpoints with any valid paid basketball plans.

params.description: Filter by a specific league or cup ID.

params.name: season
params.description:
Used together with leagueId to retrieve matches for a specific season, e.g. 25-26. 
 
 

Returns the current season by default.

params.name: matchId
params.description: Filter by a specific match ID. Only matches from the current season are supported.

items.docs: • This API endpoint returns basic schedule and result information for basketball matches. You can use it with the Match Modify Record endpoint to track any post-publication corrections to match data. • One of the following parameters is required: date, leagueId, or matchId — these three cannot be used together in the same request. items.docs: • This API endpoint returns basic information for leagues and cups. Optionally filter by a specific leagueId; if omitted, the endpoint returns basic information for all leagues and cups. Click here to view all leagues & cups. • Tips: You have access to all the basketball Common API endpoints with any valid paid basketball plans.

• This API endpoint returns a list of all countries covered by iSports API, along with each country's unique ID. 



• The countryId can be used to filter or reference country-specific data across other Basketball endpoints.

• This API endpoint returns a list of all bookmakers supported by iSports Basketball API, along with their corresponding bookmaker IDs. 



• Note that companyIdEu, companyIdMainSpread, and companyIdMainTotal belong to three independent ID systems used by different odds endpoints — the same bookmaker may have different IDs across these three fields, and they should not be used interchangeably.
